sonnet.problem: This true/false only restates what card 2 (the LORD commanded it through Moses) and card 5 (the tribes give the cities) already established. It tests no new claim.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: This card carries no part of the passage. It only announces that the last line is coming and comments on how the chapter is built, then sets up a choice card.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. ... He talks as "I" and never comments on how he tells the passage.

sonnet.problem: This story card repeats the fact card 14 just asked and revealed (not one promise failed). It adds nothing new from the passage and works as a recap.
sonnet.rule: No recap cards. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: Moses is mentioned ("the twelve spies Moses sent") with no short label saying who he is. He first appears in this passage as an answer on card 2, and he is never introduced.
sonnet.rule: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."
